captions.detailed: A 3D model of a cross-drilling vise featuring a wide, rectangular, dark gray base plate. The main assembly includes a fixed rear V-block jaw and a moving front V-block jaw, both colored light gray with horizontal V-grooves. The moving jaw slides along two parallel, cylindrical steel-colored guide rails and is driven by a central threaded leadscrew operated by a T-bar handle with black end caps.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D cross-drilling vise with a wide rectangular base, a fixed rear V-block jaw, and a movable front V-block jaw driven by a central leadscrew and T-bar handle along parallel guide rails.
captions.factory: The code constructs a rectangular base plate using a box primitive, upon which a swivel turntable is integrated. Parallel guide rods and a central screw shaft are modeled as cylinders. The fixed and sliding jaws are constructed by applying boolean subtractions (V-cuts) on block primitives. A T-bar handle is assembled using a central cylindrical hub, a cross-bar cylinder, and two small end-cap boxes.
